## What landed (implementation, `a39b84a8`)

- `exports/src/exports/entity_page.py` — the `sig.entity-page/1`
  contract (K2 §6.2). `page_state` renders the A-10 decision
  (`published` / `not_yet_reviewed` / `withheld` / `unpaged`);
  `build_twin` emits the record — claims grouped by predicate with the
  four epistemic fields separate (SIG-UI-004), H-2 relationship rows in
  both directions (entity-ref claims + materialized access edges joined
  on claim id) with historical and undated marked (SIG-UI-088/116),
  `access.degree_only` as node attributes never edges (SIG-UI-117's
  shape), SIG-UI-080's withheld notice verbatim when a counterparty
  drops, and the contract-B sections (`contradictions`, `timeline`,
  `related`, `downloads`) as typed empty values so the record shape is
  stable across waves.
- `exports/src/exports/spine_export.py` — the `entity_page_claims`
  export seam (publishable claims on page-kind subjects AND objects,
  rights-joined for compartment filing) and the per-compartment
  emission at `web/entity/<url_type>/<slug>--<hash>/index.<comp>.json`,
  schema-registered so the release descriptor lists it
  (SIG-EXPORT-014).
- `web/src/lib/entity-page.ts` — the TypeScript mirror: twin and
  review-record types, `pageState`, `entityIndex` (SIG-UI-070 per-kind
  counts + the ER disclosure verbatim), committed fixtures (the
  auto-allowed agency twin + the `not_yet_reviewed` organisation pair —
  the A-10 fixture exercises the answered decision verbatim).
- `web/src/lib/data.ts` — `getEntityLabelRows()` +
  `getEntityPageTwins(urlType, key)`: export mode scans
  `labels/*.jsonl` + `web/entity/<type>/<key>/index.*.json`; a
  `not_yet_reviewed` or withheld entity answers `[]` — the typed state
  rides the label registry, never a broken page.
- `tests/exports/test_entity_pages.py` (13 tests — A-10 legs, H-2
  fields, withheld-counterparty drop, degree-never-edge,
  per-compartment emission, end-to-end `build_spine_export` twin) +
  `web/tests/unit/entity-page.test.ts` (17 tests).
- `CHANGELOG.md` entry under `## [Unreleased]`.

## Fix arc (this resume)

- `a39b84a8` (inherited): the implementation. CI run 41249484600 —
  web leg red: `check-root-absolute-paths` measured 7 new
  root-absolute sites in `web/src/lib/entity-page.ts` (the committed
  fixtures spelled `"/entity/…"` and `"/r/…"` literals). The artifact
  `url`/`record_url` fields ARE root-absolute bytes
  (`policy.labels.entity_url` → `/entity/<type>/<key>/`), so the values
  are correct — the literal spelling is what the containment rule
  counts, and the baseline may only shrink.
- `ac232001`: the fixtures now build the identical values through
  `withBase()` with a sans-slash argument — the pinned construction
  seam (`provenance-panel.ts` precedent). `fixtureEntityUrl` mirrors
  `policy.labels.entity_url`; `check-root-absolute-paths` green
  (7 sites → 0; the two pre-existing shrink advisories are advisory,
  exit 0). The check was not loosened; the baseline is untouched.
